title: Reduction time bound
statement: Let $N,d,c,V,CV,c_V$ be the machine and natural-number parameters in the definitions of the reduction bounds, and let $x,\sigma$ be Boolean strings such that the length of $\sigma$ is the reduction's output-width bound at input length $|x|$. Then $CV\bigl((|\langle x,\sigma\rangle|+1)^{c_V}\bigr)$ is at most the reduction's time bound at input length $|x|$, where $\langle x,\sigma\rangle$ is the specified pairing encoding.
hypotheses_covered: $N,d,c,V,CV,c_V$ are the parameters in the reduction-bound definitions
$|\sigma|$ equals the reduction output-width bound at $|x|$
